task.title: Add a family with children
task.shortdesc: Join two partners, record their marriage and add their children, from people who are already in your tree.

prereq.p: Add the partners and the children first. shows how.

step.cmd: Open one of the partners. Choose , then under Add to the workspace, then .

info.p: A page also has the button , under the parents and partners of the person.

stepresult.p: A form opens. The person you came from is already in one of the partner boxes.

step.cmd: Select the other partner's box and type the name.

stepresult.p: A short list of people appears under the box. Each shows the years of the person.

step.cmd: Choose the person from the list.

info.p: The name only counts once you choose it from the list. This way the family uses the person who is already in the tree and does not make a copy.

step.cmd: Scroll down and fill in and .

info.p: Leave them empty if you do not know them. You can add them later with .

stepresult.p: A small box opens with a search box.

step.cmd: Type the child's name, choose the person from the list, then choose .

info.p: Repeat the last two steps for each child. A row shows the child's name once you have chosen. If you type but do not choose, the row says to choose a person from the list, or to clear the box.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom and choose .

stepresult.p: The family is saved. A box may ask whether to discard changes. The family is already saved, so choosing only closes the form. The page of the family opens.

result.p: The page of the family lists the partners, the marriage and the children. Choose to see the family drawn out.
To change a family later, choose on its page. The page of the family also has .
